# AlwaysBuffed

> AlwaysBuffed is a free addon for World of Warcraft: Forever. It ranks food, elixirs, weapon buffs, and other consumables by character spec, shows bag counts and optional cached Auctionator prices, and tracks active buffs in a buff bar and radial wheel.

## Install and use

- [Latest release](https://github.com/SPDUK/AlwaysBuffed/releases/latest): Download the ZIP ending in `-forever.zip`. Extract the `AlwaysBuffed` folder into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`.
- [Addon guide](https://github.com/SPDUK/AlwaysBuffed#readme): Enable AlwaysBuffed in the character selection screen’s AddOns menu. Type `/ab` or `/alwaysbuffed` in game. Auctionator is optional and supplies pricing after a full scan at the auction house.

## Reference

- [Spec rankings](https://github.com/SPDUK/AlwaysBuffed/blob/HEAD/docs/spec-rankings.md): How rankings differ across classes and talent builds.
- [Consumable catalog](https://github.com/SPDUK/AlwaysBuffed/blob/HEAD/docs/catalog.md): Tracked categories, items, spells, and buff behavior.
- [Profession buffs](https://github.com/SPDUK/AlwaysBuffed/blob/HEAD/docs/profession-buffs.md): Type `/alwaysbuffed` or `/ab` and select Professions. Equipping any fishing pole selects Fishing in Automatic mode. Herbalism Tea appears on the default Combat bar when enabled. Mages can also select Comprehension. Both command aliases accept `wheel`, `lock`, `unlock`, `fishgear <item link or ID>`, and `fishgear clear`.
- [Bar controls and language support](https://github.com/SPDUK/AlwaysBuffed#in-game): In General, set Icons grow to Left, Right, Up, or Down. The interface follows the WoW client language.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/SPDUK/AlwaysBuffed/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md): Release notes and fixes.
- [GitHub issues](https://github.com/SPDUK/AlwaysBuffed/issues): Bug reports and feature requests.
